title: How is Cleopatra connected to Hello Kitty?
description:
A Baroque painting, Rome's first dynasty, a Renaissance fresco, the line of popes, a golf selfie and a Yokohama reception connect Cleopatra to Hello Kitty.

Cleopatra → Julius Caesar → Nero → Saint Peter → Pope Francis → Donald Trump → Shinzo Abe → Hello Kitty

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Cleopatra → Julius Caesar: Around 1637, Pietro da Cortona painted Julius Caesar giving Cleopatra the throne of Egypt.
   Photo by Pietro da Cortona, CC BY-SA 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:C%C3%A9sar_remet_Cl%C3%A9op%C3%A2tre_sur_le_tr%C3%B4ne_d%27%C3%89gypte_-_Pierre_de_Cortone.jpg
2. Julius Caesar → Nero (6 portraits, every holder): Caesar's heir Augustus became Rome's first emperor, and his dynasty ended with Nero.
   Photo, Public domain / CC BY-SA 4.0 / Attribution / CC BY-SA 2.0 / CC BY 2.5: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Retrato_de_Julio_C%C3%A9sar_(26724093101)_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Augustus_of_Prima_Porta.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:8095_-_Roma_-_Ara_Pacis_-_Tiberio_-_Foto_Giovanni_Dall%27Orto_-_28-Mar-2008.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Caligula.Carlsberg_Glyptotek.(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Claudius_crop.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nero_Glyptothek_Munich_321.jpg
3. Nero → Saint Peter: Around 1482, Filippino Lippi painted Nero putting the apostle Peter, the first pope, on trial.
   Photo by see filename or category, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cappella_brancacci,_Disputa_di_Simon_Mago_(restaurato),_Filippino_Lippi.jpg
4. Saint Peter → Pope Francis (9 portraits, every holder): From Peter, the line of popes runs unbroken to the 266th, Pope Francis.
   Photo, Public domain / CC0 / CC BY-SA 3.0 / unknown: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:St._Peter_(portrayed_as_a_Roman_consul).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Herrera_mozo_San_Le%C3%B3n_magno_Lienzo._%C3%93valo._164_x_105_cm._Museo_del_Prado.png + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Exultet_Rolls_of_Southern_Italy,_detail_of_Pope_Gregory_VII.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Innocent_III_(Monastery_of_Subiaco).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pedro_Berruguete_-_Portrait_of_Pope_Sixtus_IV_della_Rovere_-_1916.815_-_Cleveland_Museum_of_ArtFXD.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_IX,_by_Adolphe_Braun,_1875.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_XII_with_tabard,_by_Michael_Pitcairn,_1951_(retouched).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ADAMELLO_-_PAPA_-_Giovanni_Paolo_II_-_panoramio_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Francis_Korea_Haemi_Castle_19_(4x5_cropped).jpg
5. Pope Francis → Donald Trump: In 2017, President Donald Trump visited Pope Francis at the Vatican.
   Photo by Shealeah Craighead, CC BY 3.0 us: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Donald_Trump_Pope_Francis_Melania_Trump_in_2017.jpg
6. Donald Trump → Shinzo Abe: In 2019, Japan's prime minister Shinzo Abe took a golf selfie with Trump near Tokyo.
   Photo by 内閣官房内閣広報室, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Selfie_of_Shinzo_Abe_and_Donald_Trump.jpg
7. Shinzo Abe → Hello Kitty: And three months later, Hello Kitty joined Abe on stage at a summit reception in Yokohama.
   Photo by TICAD7 Photographs, CC0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Welcome_Reception_co-hosted_by_Prime_Minister_of_Japan_and_Mayor_of_the_City_of_Yokohama_(48636282272).jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
